description: Update src/index.css with cinematic glassmorphic utility classes and update PublicLayout.tsx to have a glassmorphic dark navigation bar and footer.
steps: In src/index.css, update the .glass-dark class to: background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.65); backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(1.4); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-radius: 24px;
In src/index.css, update the .glass-card class to: background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.5); backdrop-filter: blur(16px); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius: 16px;
In src/index.css, update body background-color to #0F172A (dark navy)

In src/components/layout/PublicLayout.tsx, redesign the navigation header: change from white/cream to bg-slate-900/70 backdrop-blur-xl, border-bottom white/10, school name in white text, nav links white with hover:text-emerald-400, Login button as glass pill with emerald accent border
In src/components/layout/PublicLayout.tsx, redesign the mobile menu to match dark glass theme
In src/components/layout/PublicLayout.tsx, redesign the footer: dark glassmorphic (bg-slate-900/80 backdrop-blur), white/slate-300 text, emerald accents for links
acceptance_criteria: The PublicLayout navigation bar uses dark glass styling with backdrop-blur-xl and white text
Footer uses dark styling consistent with the glassmorphic theme
CSS utility classes .glass-dark and .glass-card are updated for dark glassmorphic design
findings: Successfully updated glass-dark and glass-card CSS classes for cinematic dark glassmorphic style, body background to #0F172A, and PublicLayout with dark glass nav/footer. Build and lint pass cleanly.
